sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must be performed every six months as indicated by M6 
 in the above title block

التقنية 
 البيانات:

This first draft is initiated and reviewed by 
 eng. Gamal Hassan Mohamed Abdo, revised by eng. Saad Basuny EDEPC Inspection quality control, 
 accepted by general director eng. Azmy Soliman Hussein, and approved by eng. 
 Mohamed Abd El Ghaffar general director of El-Salam Diesel PS.

This document 
certified 
by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS 
coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة
Work order must be issued before start work
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area

Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes, and safety 
 clothes when cleaning.
Wear safety belt when cleaning insulators.
The generator must be in case of shutdown.

The personal shall perform the safety operation 
 so as all the live parts are de energized, earthed and equipped with warnings 
 before removing the protection and connection main circuit.
